# Report a security problem

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/xmpuspus/airgap/security/advisories/new)
for a suspected vulnerability. Do not put exploit details, credentials, private
data, or an unfixed vulnerability in a public issue.

Include the affected commit or version, platform, configuration mode, steps to
reproduce, expected impact, and any tested mitigation. Remove tokens, customer
records, and proprietary knowledge documents.

Airgap supports the `main` branch and the latest tagged minor release. Older
minor releases receive security fixes only when the maintainer can make a safe
backport.

Read the complete [security policy](../SECURITY.md) for response targets, design
boundaries, known risks, and dependency handling.
